title: GAFC - Assume Loaded Quiz
body:
💯💥 💯 Alright, GAFC crew, let's keep it real. You just picked up a firearm – maybe it's yours, maybe your cousin's – and you *think* it's unloaded. What's the Golden Rule move, before anything else? 🤔

Nah, fam! Gloxsie 21 always reminds Bobo Licious: EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. you touch a firearm, act like it's ready to sing. Assume it's loaded, always. No exceptions. 💥

This ain't just about you; it's about protecting our loved ones, our block, and upholding the legacy of safety in our homes. As Elder Johnson from Church of Legacy says, 'Vigilance is a form of love.' ❤️

So, real talk: What's YOUR non-negotiable first step when you pick up a firearm? Share your wisdom in the comments – let's build our safety toolkit together! 👇

#GAFCSafety #CommunityFirst #GunSafetyIsLove #BlackAndBrownOwned #LegacyOfSafety #RealTalk
